sloka: हनुमांश्चिन्तयामास मतिमान् मारुतात्मजः।एवं गृहीते सुग्रीवे किं कर्तव्यं मया भवेत् ।। ६.६७.७४ ।।
transliteration: hanumāṁścintayāmāsa matimān mārutātmajaḥ।evaṁ gṛhīte sugrīve kiṁ kartavyaṁ mayā bhavet ।। 6.67.74 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the army running away here and there and Sugriva being captured by Kumbhakarna, wise Hanuman, the son of Maruti started thinking.
